title: Synthetic example — Citation support with and without an audit

passages.text: The mock study compared two drafting pipelines on the same 30 literature questions. Each pipeline used the same English passages and generated English and Indonesian drafts. A human reviewer classified factual claims according to whether the cited passage supported them.

In this illustrative dataset, unsupported claims fell from 12 of 60 to 6 of 60 in the Indonesian drafts after adding the audit. The English drafts had 5 unsupported claims of 60 in both conditions. The study did not measure citation recall or publication readiness.
